tags.description:
**Migration** endpoints report data conditions that would make a one-time data migration fail, so they can be remediated before the migration runs.

The **LAR phase 1 migration sanity check** lists, per check, every account and ticker that blocks the migration. The tenant is ready to migrate once every list in the response is empty.
tags.name: Migrations

tags.description:
A **rewrap** operation updates the wrapping of vault secret material when the HSM master key is rotated. This ensures that vault seed and signature keys remain usable after HSM key rotation events.

The **vault** polls for pending rewrap requests and submits the rewrapped key material back to the system. The rewrap process is transparent to accounts and does not affect their ability to sign transactions once completed.

Rewrap operations are triggered by a rewrap intent and follow a lazy rotation pattern where vault seeds are rewrapped on-demand rather than all at once.
tags.name: Rewraps
